topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It’s funny how things work out. I spent months chatting with this person online, laughing at inside jokes and sharing my deepest thoughts. Every key stroke felt like a step closer to a real friendship, even though we were miles apart. Then, last week, I found out we live in the same city. I don’t know, it just feels like there’s this sudden gap, a space that didn’t seem so wide when it was filled with digital distance. I guess I’m just processing, wondering if we can bridge this new kind of space.
